title: 1986 AHSME Problem 8
statement: The population of the United States in \(1980\) was \(226{,}504{,}825.\) The area of the country is \(3{,}615{,}122\) square miles. There are \((5280)^2\) square feet in one square mile. Which number below best approximates the average number of square feet per person?

solutions.text:
The average is approximately \[ \begin{aligned} &\frac{(3.615\times10^6)(5280)^2} {2.265\times10^8}\\ &\qquad\approx 4.45\times10^5 \end{aligned} \] square feet per person. Of the choices, this is closest to \(500{,}000.\)

Thus the correct answer is E.
hints: Divide total square feet by population
Round the given values to two significant digits before multiplying
